_comment: One implementation per concept (user, 2026-11-09 ~17:25: "sono al stessa cosa e stessa classe come fanno a essere diverse, evita che stessi concetti abbiano codice diverso"). Each concept has OWNER files (the only place its signatures may appear) and signatures = line regexes (comments and imports ignored; an object with `near` needs a second regex within 15 lines of the line). A wrapper that only passes parameters has no signature and is fine. `known` = a second implementation that exists today, with its reason; it is listed in the report. Generic form: design-method/scripts (addon concept-owners, config conceptOwners). Test: ConceptOwnershipTest (CR-76 / CR-77). Every `known` entry carries a `decision` (the user's or the pending-owner note); the orchestrator removes an entry when the second implementation is gone. Signatures describe the implementation (spring, pointer pass, tags), never a function name, so a thin delegating wrapper has none.

concepts.name: enable banking setup (native panel)
concepts._why: Wave 16, user approval 2026-11-09 ~23:50 ('Si, schermate vanno bene'): one EB setup flow. The hidden page and its scripts live in EbPanel/WebViewEbPage; the screens host one WebViewEbPage.

concepts.name: sync bar (2 dp refresh / sync line)
concepts._why: Polish 2, owner G: one 2 dp bar with exact semantics bounds (Material's indicator enlarges them to about 22 dp and the node overlapped the text above). Home's sync line, the pull-to-refresh bar and the provider card's bar are all SyncBar in ui/Kit.kt. The Agente working line (determinate-free, transparent track, own colour, no 'Aggiornamento in corso' label) is the one known second form.

known.reason: The assistant's 'working' line: a 2 dp indicator with a transparent track in the action colour, labelled by the surrounding row, not a data sync; it keeps its own placeholder spacer of the same height.
known.decision: pending-owner note (Polish 2 G): merge into SyncBar with a label parameter if the user wants it.

concepts.name: clipboard read
concepts._why: Wave 17, user 2026-11-10: the app never reads the clipboard unasked. Every primaryClip / coerceToText read for use lives behind ClipboardSource so a test can fake it and count. Polish 3 (2026-11-10): the Agente hand-off and its reply paste are gone; ai/WebChat.kt stays listed only for the CLIPBOARD_SERVICE handle of ClipWrite (a write); it reads no clip.

concepts.name: clipboard write and own-clip clear
concepts._why: Polish 3 2026-11-10: the app writes the clipboard only on a person's tap (the routine's instructions, an assistant reply under AG-REPLY). One owner, ClipWrite in ai/WebChat.kt; nothing is tracked or cleared.

concepts.name: setup action row (title + caption, full width)
concepts._why: G-17 / EB-2, 2026-11-10: a group of setup actions is one set of full-width rows with a title and a caption; one owner, SetupActionRow in ui/setup/SetupFlow.kt.

concepts.name: sibling action row by role (confirm rightmost)
concepts._why: G-17(d) / CR-96, 2026-11-10 (user: confirm sits on the right): a Row of buttons is laid out by RoleActionRow in ui/CardKit.kt (confirm and secondary passed by role, tags applied there). A hand-built Row with spacing near a PillButton is a second implementation.
